Evelyn Park: quick sync 10am PT tomorrow for vendor roadmap handoff. main asks: H200 thermal notes, MI300 quant stability, Gaudi firmware rollback plan.
Marco Ruiz: lab slots confirmed. H200 cluster 09:30PT, Gaudi racks 10:00PT, MI300 bench 10:30PT.
Claire Ng: marketing wants one-line approved copy for marketplace tile. propose: "Verified on Redwood Dedicated: H100/H200, MI300, Gaudi (see details)"
Vendor-NVIDIA: ok to use that copy. FYI H200 fw v1.2.5 reduces peak clocks; tail-lat improvements but watch for sustained 95C on some racks. recommend a pre-run patch window.
Vendor-AMD: MI300 quant kernels stable on our bench but some operator flags for int8 on LlamaX. we'll attach eval script.
Vendor-Gaudi: gaudi-fw v3.2.2 includes rollback artifacts. suggest env GAUDI_POWER=balanced for long-run. we'll standby for firmware window.
Evelyn Park: Ops ask: can each vendor reserve 20min pre-test for patching? also add comp-matrix to runbook.
Vendor-NVIDIA: yes 20min ok. will provide patched runtime tag `nvidia-h200-runtime:1.5.1-rt` before the run.
Marco Ruiz: CI plan: smoke (10m) -> perf (40m) -> soak (2h). Ops-Bot will post run ids.
Ops-Bot: run queued id=ci-26890, images pending.
Claire Ng: marketing note: please redact any vendor-internal logs from the summary. we'll publish conservative TPS numbers.
Evelyn Park: assigned actions: Marco -> lab reservations confirmed (done), Claire -> marketplace copy approval (pending legal), Vendors -> post image tags + rollback docs.
Vendor-Gaudi: will upload rollback artifact by EOD.
Vendor-AMD: eval scripts in repo now.
Vendor-NVIDIA: image tag posted.
Evelyn Park: great. see you tomorrow 10am PT. ping here with any last-minute blockers. :white_check_mark:
